description: Lists the published collections of the Origine Paris catalogue with the pieces this server serves in each, in French or English. Use it to see the catalogue by collection before searching: every visible collection carries its title, handle, page URL, number of pieces, published price range, the jewellery types it holds and the page where its description is published; the list is complete, unpaginated and alphabetical by title. Do not use it to find a piece (search_catalogue, whose collection filter takes a handle from this list), for the record of one piece (get_product_detail) or for the house and its founders (get_maison). lang selects the titles and URLs; a title the site does not publish in English is served in French and a notice names the collections concerned. Counts and prices are computed from the pieces this server serves, so a collection with no served piece is listed with a count of 0 and no price; technical collections hidden from the agentic view are not listed; the description text itself is not relayed (status not_served, see the collection page). Read-only: the list comes from the daily-refreshed index, never from a live read of the site, and nothing is invented.

lang.description: Language of the titles and page URLs: "fr" or "en". A title the site does not publish in English is served in French and named in a notice.

name: list_collections

description.description: The collection description is not relayed by this server: status not_served, the collection page as source.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 date the source was read.

source.description: URL of the page, feed or entity the value was read from.

status.description: published: read as is from the source; not_published: the source does not carry it in this language; not_served: this server does not relay this field for this item, see the source; unknown: the source could not be read.

handle.description: Collection handle, the value search_catalogue takes in its collection filter.

jewellery_types.description: Jewellery types present among the served pieces, in a fixed order.

piece_count.description: Pieces of this collection served by this server.

price.description: Lowest and highest published prices among the served pieces; null when none is served.

title_language.description: Language of the title served: the requested one, or fr when the site publishes no English title.

url.description: Collection page on origineparis.com in the requested language.

title: The published collections
